evals.prompt: I'm adding a new internal REST endpoint for our task management API — POST /api/tasks and GET /api/tasks/:id. Can you help me design the request/response contracts and error handling?
evals.expected_output: A consistent contract design: TypeScript-style input/output interfaces, a single structured error format, pagination consideration for list endpoints, and boundary validation guidance.
expectations: Recommends a consistent structured error response format (e.g. { error: { code, message } }) applied to all endpoints
Distinguishes input types from output types (e.g. CreateTaskInput vs Task)
Notes that list endpoints should support pagination
Follows REST naming conventions (plural nouns, no verbs in URLs)
States validation should happen at the API boundary, not scattered through internal code
